bootstrap.procedure: Paired game resampling with replacement; shared row indices across comparisons; percentile interval with linear (B-1)*q interpolation.

criterion.criterion: Strict dominance using supplied season win fraction and average point differential: home weaker if both are strictly lower; away weaker if both are strictly higher. Ties, discordant indicators, unavailable/nonfinite statistics or zero completed games are unassessable. Flag successful A LR>1 for weaker home, or LR<1 for weaker away. Never adjust or exclude a forecast.
